intro: Everyone is born with one nature: Wave, Flame, Root, Breeze, Soil or Lightning.
As you grow, creatures of your own nature come to trust you. Up to five of them. Never more, and never any other kind.
That's the law of the six lands. Or it was.
From the Citadel at the heart of the Rift, six outcasts have always raided the lands, and the lands have always held them off.
Lately the raids are winning. Nobody knows why.
hero_intro: {hero} of {land} was to marry {sweetheart} this spring.
Then {sweetheart} vanished. The same night, the Citadel's banners were seen on the border.
{hero} knows who leads the {element} raiders: {nem_first}, the one the lands now call {nemesis}. They grew up side by side, too alike to stay friends, and both in love with {sweetheart}.
{sweetheart} never thought much of either of them. {Sw_their} {sw_element} creature beat them both, every time.
{hero} is certain {nem_first} has taken {sw_them}. The road to the Citadel crosses five lands. Each has a Lord, and no Lord lets a stranger pass without a battle.
lord_appears: {lord}, Lord of {land}, steps into the road!
lord_wins: Not today. Come back when you're stronger.
ally_offers: Let me have a go. {lord} hasn't seen what I can do.

win_specific.clutch: I had you on the ropes. How are you still standing?
win_specific.fast: That was over before I'd even warmed up. I've never lost that fast.
win_specific.uphill: My {e_noun} should have swallowed your {p_noun} whole. It didn't. How?
win_specific.guard: Every time I struck, you were already braced for it. You read me perfectly.
win_specific.plain: You hardly leaned on your {p_noun} at all. That was pure skill.
win_specific.misses: Half blind, and you still kept coming.
win_specific.advantage: Your {p_noun} went straight through my {e_noun}. I never stood a chance.
win_specific.default: You and {creature} move like one. I couldn't find a gap.

win_general: You {folk} folk are {trait} than I gave you credit for.
win_by_ally: Beaten by {ally}, of all people. And {ally_they} follow{ally_s} you?
Then there's more to you than I saw.
tell_quest: {hero} tells {lord} about {sweetheart}, and the road to the Citadel.

1: The raiders hit us hard last month. Their creatures fought like one mind, as if something was holding them together.
3: One of their captains had a creature that wasn't of his own nature. I told myself I'd imagined it. Nobody can do that.

citadel_intro: Six lands. Six natures. One road left.
The Citadel stands on the Rift itself. Here, the bond between trainer and creature runs stronger than anywhere in the lands.
Once we're inside, there's no resting. Whatever hurts us on one floor, we carry to the next.
Each of the six outcasts holds a floor. Each of them grew up beside one of you.
ally_claims: I know every trick {nem_first} has. This one's mine.
{hero}, call it if you see something I don't.
ally_out: My {creature} is in no state to fight. Someone will have to stand in for me.
first_down: Not bad. But I stopped playing by the old rules a long time ago.
sixth_reveal_first: {nemesis} sends out a sixth creature. A {beater} one.
That's impossible. You're {element}, like me. You can't bond a second nature. Nobody can!
Five of a kind tear each other apart. A sixth, of a stronger nature, keeps them in line. Did you never wonder why we started winning?
sixth_reveal_later: {nemesis} sends out a sixth creature. {Beater}: the nature that beats {ally}'s.
Another one. They've all learned it.
floor_clear: Floor {floor} is clear. There's no time to rest.
floor_lost: The party can't go on. Everyone falls back to the stairs.
final_enter: The top of the Citadel. The Rift howls overhead.
final_no_creature: You climbed all this way with nothing left to fight me with? Come back when you can stand.
final_first_down: You've seen the trick by now. A sixth, of the nature that beats yours.
You know how to answer that. Don't you?
hybrid_reveal: Did you think it was only {beater}? I didn't just train a second nature, {hero}. I bred the two together.
My strongest {element} creature, and the strongest {beater} creature in the lands. Hers.
Whatever you send, it becomes the half that hurts you most.
final_ally_cheer: Then we find something that stands up to both halves. Think, {hero}!
outro: {hybrid} falls. For a moment, nobody moves.
It's over, {nem_first}. How did you do it? Tell me the secret.
All right. All right! I'll tell you. Just...
{nem_first} bolts for the Rift, and is gone.
Nobody took me. I went. {nem_first} had done something no one had ever done, and I wanted to see it.
And then I watched you cross five lands and climb this tower without it.
Don't worry about the secret. {Nem_they} told me everything. I'll tell you.

end.title: THE END
end.line: {hero} and {sweetheart} went home to {land}. The five Lords went with them as far as the border.
end.stats: Battles lost along the way: {losses}.   Turns fought: {turns}.
